name: Intra-Company Transfer (ICT) Permit

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a senior manager/key personnel role, a salary of at least €49,523/year (from 1 March 2026), and at least 6 months' prior employment with the multinational group (1 month for trainees).
requirements.fix_path: Meet the tenure and salary requirements.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of 6+ months' prior employment with the multinational group

sources.title: Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permit - Department of Enterprise, Trade and Employment

notes: FORMULA VALUE, tier-1 confirmed at €49,523 (from 1 March 2026, up from €46,000). GENUINE STRUCTURAL EXCLUSION worth flagging: ICT time does NOT count toward Stamp 4 — a real and consequential gap, since every other Irish work-sponsored route in this dataset (CSEP, GEP) does build toward Stamp 4 eventually. Dependants must obtain their own separate permit — family_can_work is false, distinct from CSEP's immediate Stamp 1G spousal work rights. Deliberately terminal in this dataset (leads_to_pr: false, no switchable_to targets) — this route exists purely for temporary multinational staff transfers, not as an immigration pathway, the same structural role played by Germany's and Netherlands' ICT routes elsewhere in this dataset.
